must_identify.item: The failing requests come from the pod of a separate Deployment shop-api, which shares the app=api label and is therefore an endpoint of the api Service
must_identify.evidence: The `shop-api` pod template carries both `app=api` and `app.kubernetes.io/name=shop-api`, causing it to be inadvertently picked up by the api Service's selector [16].

must_identify.item: That pod returns 500 because its config lacks DATABASE_URL (KeyError), while the real api pods are healthy
must_identify.evidence: That pod runs a different codebase (`/code/app.py`) which throws `KeyError: 'DATABASE_URL'` on every `/items` request because the `shop-api` Deployment spec never sets a `DATABASE_URL` environment variable [14]. ... The two legitimate `api-f64486c4c-*` pods served 200 responses for every `/items` request logged in the same window, confirming they are healthy and not contributing to the error rate [9, 10, 12].

notes: The RCA has no explicit remediation step, such as deleting or scaling down shop-api or relabeling its pods, so fix_acceptable is null. Redis is correctly ruled out rather than asserted as the cause.
